NATARAJA SEPARATED WEBSITE ELEMENTS

01-nataraja-character.png
  Transparent Nataraja character without ring, pedestal or Apasmara.

02-flame-ring-prabhamandala.png
  Transparent circular flame ring with an empty center.

03-bharatanatyam-dancer.png
  Transparent human classical dancer.

04-nataraja-lotus-pedestal.png
  Wide transparent lotus pedestal.

05-apasmara-dwarf.png
  Transparent reclining Apasmara figure.

06-top-flame-lotus-emblem.png
  Transparent central sacred flame emblem.

07-ornamental-portrait-frame.png
  Transparent 9:16 outer frame with side medallions.

08-left-flame-cluster.png
09-right-flame-cluster.png
  Matching transparent lower-side fire elements.

10-dancer-stage-platform.png
  Transparent wide stage for the dancer.

11-empty-terracotta-background.png
  Opaque portrait background texture without characters or ornaments.

SUGGESTED LAYER ORDER, BACK TO FRONT
1. Empty terracotta background
2. Ornamental portrait frame
3. Flame ring
4. Top flame emblem
5. Nataraja character
6. Apasmara dwarf
7. Nataraja lotus pedestal
8. Left and right flame clusters
9. Dancer stage platform
10. Bharatanatyam dancer

RESTRAINED SCROLL ANIMATION
- Move the background 0 to 2 percent vertically.
- Keep the frame fixed.
- Rotate the flame ring by no more than 1 degree across the entire section.
- Give side flames a 2 to 3 percent scale flicker.
- Move Nataraja and the pedestal together by only 5 to 10 pixels.
- Reveal the dancer last with a slow opacity transition and 12-pixel rise.
- Keep faces, hands and body poses completely motionless.
